g.text: a_c = 2ηP/(cσ), P/c = 4.54 µN/m² at 1 AU; σ uses total spacecraft mass. (b) Lines: quasi-circular spiral, cone angle 35.3°, T = √(μ/r₀) |(r/r₀)^1.5 − 1| / (3 × 0.385 a_c).
Dots: numerical flat-sail trajectories steered to change orbital energy fastest — time to first reach the distance, without matching the planet's velocity.
